NPA's of slightly more than 6,000 pounds GVWR have a curb weight of 100 pounds, or more, above those vehicles subject to the AFES. These vehicles also have a higher (CID)X(N/V). Assuming that in MY 1976 the vehicles slightly above 6,000 pounds GVWR have an average (CID)X(N/V) which is the same as that for vehicles below 6,000 pounds GVWR in MY 1976 and that in MY 1979 vehicles under 6,000 pounds GVWR exhibit the (CID)X(N/V) projected to meet the AFES, then the average fuel economy of those vehicles slightly over 6,000 pounds GVWR would be 17.2 mpg assuming no fuel economy penalty due to the MY 1979 emission standard.
,
The estimated fuel economy results from a projection of the production weighted average fuel economy in MY 1979 of 18.2 mpg for domestic NPA's of less than 6,000 pounds GVWR to vehicles of slightly more than 6,000 pounds GVWR which have 100 pounds greater weight and 12.5 percent higher (CID)X(N/V), based on analytically derived sensitivities of fuel economy to weight and (CID)X(N/V).
